notes: All production LLM calls go through the Vercel AI SDK with model: getModel(toolName) from src/config.ts. The provider is picked at runtime by env LLM_PROVIDER (default 'gemini' in config.json -> @ai-sdk/google createGoogleGenerativeAI with GEMINI_API_KEY; 'openai' -> createOpenAI with OPENAI_API_KEY and optional OPENAI_BASE_URL env (vendor default when empty), compatibility 'strict' = chat completions; 'vertex' -> @ai-sdk/google-vertex, used by jina-ai/config.json). Per-tool model ids come from config.json: gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-flash-lite, openai gpt-4o-mini, all Router catalog ids. Classified by the default (gemini) provider: Google endpoint via another vendor's provider with catalog models -> handoff (rule 7). The openai branch alone would be migrated (rule 8); the vertex branch alone would be kept (rule 2). ObjectGeneratorSafe.generateObject(...) wrapper calls in agent.ts, app.ts, evaluator.ts, query-rewriter.ts, etc. are not AI SDK calls and are not counted; the AI SDK calls they reach are in safe-generator.ts. Jina embeddings/rerank/classify raw HTTP calls are listed as kept; Jina reader (r.jina.ai), search (svip.jina.ai), datetime API, Brave and Serper search are not LLM calls and are excluded.
